title: Mock Test 03 (harder)

questions.question: ISRO's SpaDeX mission, launched in December 2024, was designed mainly to demonstrate:
options: docking of two spacecraft in orbit
questions.explanation: SpaDeX (Space Docking Experiment) achieved India's first in-orbit docking in January 2025.

questions.question: CERT-In, India's national agency for responding to cyber security incidents, functions under the:
options: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
questions.explanation: CERT-In is under MeitY, set up under Section 70B of the IT Act.

questions.question: Which country held the G20 presidency and hosted the G20 Leaders' Summit in 2025?
questions.explanation: India hosted in 2023, Brazil in 2024, South Africa in 2025 (Johannesburg).

questions.question: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is jointly hosted by:
options: the United States, Canada and Mexico
questions.explanation: 2026 is the first World Cup with 48 teams, across the USA, Canada and Mexico; 2030 goes to Spain, Portugal and Morocco.

questions.question: BHASHINI, a Government of India initiative, is mainly concerned with:
options: AI-based translation and speech tools for Indian languages
questions.explanation: BHASHINI (Bhasha Interface for India) is the National Language Translation Mission under MeitY.

questions.question: India won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 by defeating which team in the final?
questions.explanation: India beat New Zealand in the final in Dubai on 9 March 2025.

questions.question: The Rust programming language was started by Graydon Hoare and developed with the backing of:
questions.explanation: Rust began as Hoare's project and was sponsored by Mozilla from 2009.

questions.question: The "Year 2038 problem" affects systems that store time as:
options: a signed 32-bit count of seconds since 1 January 1970
a BCD date in the BIOS
questions.explanation: A signed 32-bit time_t overflows at 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038.

questions.question: A and B together finish a job in 12 days, B and C in 15 days, and C and A in 20 days. In how many days can A alone finish it?
questions.explanation: Chairs = LCM 60. A+B 5, B+C 4, C+A 3 a day, so A+B+C = 6 and A = 6 − 4 = 2; 60/2 = 30.

questions.question: Pipes A and B fill a tank in 12 h and 15 h; pipe C empties it in 20 h. All three are opened on an empty tank, and C is closed after 5 hours. When is the tank full, counted from the start?
questions.explanation: Tank 60 L: A 5, B 4, C −3 per hour. 5 h × 6 = 30 L; remaining 30 L at 9 L/h = 3 h 20 min.

questions.question: Trains of 120 m and 180 m run on parallel tracks in the same direction at 54 km/h and 36 km/h. How long does the faster train take to pass the slower one completely?
questions.explanation: Relative speed 18 km/h = 5 m/s; distance 120 + 180 = 300 m; 300/5 = 60 s.

questions.question: A boat goes 30 km upstream and 44 km downstream in 10 hours, and 40 km upstream and 55 km downstream in 13 hours. Its speed in still water is:
questions.explanation: Solving gives upstream 5 and downstream 11 km/h; boat speed = (5 + 11)/2 = 8.

questions.question: The price of sugar rises by 25%. A family raises its sugar budget by 10%. By what percent must it cut its consumption?
questions.explanation: Consumption = 1.10/1.25 = 0.88 of the old amount, a 12% cut.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks goods 40% above cost price and allows two successive discounts of 10% each. His profit percent is:
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum for 3 years at 10% per annum is Rs. 93. The sum is:
A can holds 80 L of milk. 8 L is taken out and replaced with water, and this is done three times in all. How much milk is left?
A starts a business with Rs. 20,000. After 5 months B joins with Rs. 30,000. Out of a profit of Rs. 45,000 at the end of the year, B's share is:
The angle between the hands of a clock at 7:38 is:
On which day of the week was 26 January 1950?
questions.explanation: Odd days: first 1600 years 0, next 300 years 1, 1901–1949 (49 years, 12 leap) 61 → 5, then 26 January → 5. Total 11 → 4 = Thursday.

questions.question: The average age of a family of 5 is 30 years. Five years ago the average age of the family was 32 years, when the youngest member had not been born. The youngest member's age now is:
questions.explanation: Now total 150. Five years ago 4 members totalled 128, so they total 148 now; youngest = 150 − 148 = 2.

questions.question: A committee of 5 is to be chosen from 6 men and 4 women so that it has at least 2 women. In how many ways can this be done?
Find the next term: 2, 3, 10, 39, 172, ?

Statements: Some keyboards are mice. No mouse is a monitor. All monitors are screens.
Conclusions: I. Some keyboards are not monitors. II. Some screens are not mice.
questions.explanation: The keyboards that are mice cannot be monitors (I). Every monitor is a screen and no monitor is a mouse, so those screens are not mice (II).

questions.question: A man walks 6 km east, turns right and walks 4 km, then turns right again and walks 9 km. How far and in which direction is he from the start?
questions.explanation: He ends 3 km west and 4 km south of the start: √(9 + 16) = 5 km, south-west.

questions.question: A + B means A is the mother of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A × B means A is the father of B; A ÷ B means A is the sister of B. Which expression shows that P is the maternal uncle of Q?
questions.explanation: P is the brother of M, and M is the mother of Q, so P is Q's maternal uncle. With M × Q he would be the paternal uncle.

questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. C is in the middle. B is at one end. D is immediately to the left of C. E is not next to D. A is not at an end. Who sits at the right end?
questions.explanation: Only B D C A E fits every clue.

questions.question: In a certain code NETWORK is written as LSPXUFO. How is SERVER written in that code?
questions.explanation: The word is reversed and every letter moved one place forward: REVRES → SFWSFT.

questions.question: Ravi is 14th from the top of a class and Mohan is 17th from the bottom. When they swap places, Ravi becomes 25th from the top. How many students are in the class?
questions.explanation: Mohan's old place is 25th from the top and 17th from the bottom: 25 + 17 − 1 = 41.

questions.question: Find the next letter: B, E, J, Q, ?
questions.explanation: Positions 2, 5, 10, 17, 26 (gaps 3, 5, 7, 9): the 26th letter is Z.

questions.question:
Statement: "The computer lab will be closed on Saturday for maintenance; all users must save their work to the server by Friday 5 pm."
Assumptions: I. Work not saved by then may be lost or unavailable. II. The lab is normally open on Saturdays.
options: Both I and II are implicit
Neither I nor II is implicit
questions.explanation: Asking users to save implies a risk to unsaved work (I), and announcing a Saturday closure implies the lab normally opens then (II).

questions.question: Find the odd one out:
questions.explanation: 51 = 3 × 17; the other three are prime.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to EPHEMERAL:
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting a very short time.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to METICULOUS:
questions.explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

questions.question: Identify the part with an error: "Neither the manager nor the technicians / was informed / about the / outage."
options: Neither the manager nor the technicians
questions.explanation: With neither ... nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (technicians): "were informed".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The committee has not yet arrived _____ a decision.
questions.explanation: The fixed phrase is "arrive at a decision".

questions.question: One word for "impossible to read":
questions.explanation: Illegible = cannot be read; ineligible = not qualified.

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect form: He said, "I have completed the backup."
options: He said that he has completed the backup.
He said that I had completed the backup.
He said that he had completed the backup.
He said that he completed the backup yesterday.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, present perfect becomes past perfect and "I" becomes "he".

questions.question: The idiom "to cut corners" means:
options: to do something cheaply or carelessly, ignoring rules
questions.explanation: Cutting corners = saving time or money by skipping proper steps.

questions.question: In an official letter, the abbreviation "Encl." below the signature shows that:
options: a copy is sent to other officers
a reply is expected within a week
documents are attached to the letter
questions.explanation: Encl. = enclosure(s); copies to others are shown by "Copy to" or "cc".

questions.question: Integrated circuits (ICs) are the defining technology of which generation of computers?
questions.explanation: Vacuum tubes (1st), transistors (2nd), ICs (3rd), microprocessors/VLSI (4th).

questions.question: The decimal value of the binary number 1011.101 is:
The octal number 745 in hexadecimal is:
The 8-bit two's complement number 10110110 represents the decimal value:
A direct-mapped cache of 16 KB with 32-byte blocks is used with 32-bit byte addresses. How many bits form the tag?
questions.explanation: Offset 5 bits, index log₂(16K/32) = 9 bits, tag = 32 − 14 = 18.

questions.question: The 32-bit value 0x12345678 is stored at address 100 on a little-endian machine. Which byte is at address 100?
questions.explanation: Little-endian stores the least significant byte at the lowest address.

What is the output?
questions.explanation: s + 3 points to the fourth character, so printing starts at K.

questions.question: What is the output?
questions.code:
int f(int n) { return n <= 1 ? 1 : n * f(n - 2); }
/* in main: */ printf("%d", f(7));

questions.question: What is the output?
questions.explanation: Precedence: >> first (8>>1 = 4), then & (5&3 = 1), then ^ (4^2 = 6), then | (1|6 = 7).

questions.question: On a typical system with 4-byte int and natural alignment, what does this print?
questions.code:
struct rec { char c; int i; char d; };
printf("%zu", sizeof(struct rec));
questions.explanation: c at 0, padding to 4, i at 4–7, d at 8, then padding to a multiple of 4: 12.

questions.explanation: Execution enters at case 2 and falls through to case 3 until break.

questions.question: What is the output?
questions.explanation: The semicolon after for() makes an empty loop body; i stops at the first value ≥ 10, which is 12.

questions.question: The value of the postfix expression 6 2 3 + − 3 8 2 / + * is:
The postfix form of A + B * C − D / E is:
questions.explanation: * and / bind tighter; + and − are left-associative: (A + (B*C)) − (D/E).

questions.question: Keys 15, 25, 35 and 20 are inserted in that order into a hash table of size 10 with h(k) = k mod 10 and linear probing. In which slot does 35 end up?
The keys 50, 30, 70, 20, 40, 60, 80, 35 are inserted in that order into an empty binary search tree. How many leaf nodes does it have?
questions.explanation: Leaves are 20, 35, 60 and 80 (40 has the child 35).

questions.question: The max-heap [50, 30, 40, 10, 20, 35] (stored as an array) has its maximum deleted in the usual way. The resulting array is:
questions.explanation: The last element 35 moves to the root and sifts down past 40.

questions.question: Processes P1, P2 and P3 arrive at times 0, 1 and 2 with burst times 5, 3 and 1. Under SRTF (preemptive shortest remaining time first), the average waiting time is:
A resource has 10 instances. P1, P2 and P3 hold 3, 2 and 2 and may need at most 9, 4 and 7. Which is a safe sequence?
questions.explanation: Free 3: only P2 (needs 2) can finish → free 5 → P3 (needs 5) → free 7 → P1 (needs 6).

questions.question: A system uses 32-bit logical addresses, 4 KB pages and 4-byte page-table entries with a single-level page table. The page table of one process takes:
questions.explanation: 2³² / 2¹² = 2²⁰ entries × 4 bytes = 4 MB.

questions.question: A counting semaphore starts at 7. Then 20 wait (P) and 15 signal (V) operations are performed. Its final value is:
After chmod 4755 prog, ls -l shows the permissions as:
questions.explanation: 4 = setuid, shown as s in the owner's execute place (lower-case because x is also set).

questions.question: ls -ld /tmp shows drwxrwxrwt. What does the final t mean?
options: files in it are deleted at every reboot
only root can create files in it
users can delete or rename only their own files in the directory
new files inherit the directory's group
questions.explanation: The sticky bit on a directory restricts deletion and renaming to the file's owner, the directory's owner and root.

questions.question: What does find /var/log -name "*.log" -mtime +7 -delete do?
options: deletes .log files modified within the last 7 days
deletes .log files last modified more than 7 days ago
deletes every file in /var/log older than 7 days
questions.explanation: -mtime +7 means modified more than 7 full days ago; -name limits it to *.log.

questions.question:
When does this crontab entry run?
30 2 * * 1-5 /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
options: at 2:30 am on days 1 to 5 of each month
every 30 minutes from 2 am, Monday to Friday
questions.explanation: Fields: minute 30, hour 2, any day of month, any month, day of week 1–5 (Mon–Fri).

questions.explanation: Without the g flag, s/// replaces only the first match on each line.

questions.question: Which command sends both the standard output and the standard error of cmd into out.txt?
questions.explanation: Redirections apply left to right: stdout goes to the file first, then stderr is copied to where stdout now points.

questions.question: Which single command starts the nginx service now and also makes it start at every boot?
questions.explanation: enable creates the boot-time link; --now also starts it immediately.

questions.question: On Debian or Ubuntu, which command tells you which installed package provides the file /usr/bin/ssh?
questions.explanation: dpkg -S searches installed packages for a file; dpkg -L lists the files of a package.

questions.question: Four 2 TB disks are combined in RAID 5. The usable capacity is about:
questions.explanation: RAID 5 gives (n − 1) disks of capacity: 3 × 2 TB.

questions.question: How many /26 subnets can be made from a /23 network?
The broadcast address of the network that contains 172.16.45.200/20 is:
questions.explanation: /20 has blocks of 16 in the third octet: 45 is in 32–47, so the broadcast is 172.16.47.255.

questions.question: The eight networks 10.1.64.0/24 to 10.1.71.0/24 are best summarised as:
questions.explanation: 8 = 2³ networks: 24 − 3 = /21, and 64 is a multiple of 8.

questions.question: A 100 Mbps link has a round-trip time of 40 ms. Its bandwidth-delay product, the data that can be in flight to keep it full, is:
The transmission delay of a 1500-byte frame on a 10 Mbps link is:
Which TCP mechanism stops a fast sender from overrunning a slow receiver?
options: flow control using the receiver's advertised window
questions.explanation: Flow control protects the receiver; congestion control protects the network.

questions.question: SNMP agents listen on UDP port ___, and traps are sent to the manager on UDP port ___.
questions.explanation: 161 for get/set requests to agents; 162 for traps. 69 is TFTP, 514 syslog.

questions.question: Which statement about TFTP is correct?
options: it runs over UDP port 69 and has no authentication
it runs over TCP port 21 and encrypts files
it needs a username and password
questions.explanation: TFTP is a minimal UDP protocol, often used for router configs and network boot.

questions.question: On a Cisco router, which command saves the current configuration so that it survives a reload?
questions.explanation: The running config lives in RAM; startup-config is in NVRAM. write erase deletes it.

questions.question: Which command captures only DNS traffic on interface eth0?
questions.explanation: -i chooses the interface and the filter "port 53" selects DNS; -c sets a packet count.

questions.question: Clients on 10.2.0.0/24 must get addresses from a DHCP server on 10.1.0.0/24, across a router. What is needed?
options: a DHCP relay agent on the router (e.g. ip helper-address)
nothing, because DHCP broadcasts cross routers
a static ARP entry for the server
questions.explanation: DHCP discovery is a broadcast; routers drop broadcasts unless they relay them.

questions.question: A Storage Area Network (SAN) mainly provides:
options: file shares over SMB or NFS
block-level storage over a dedicated network, e.g. Fibre Channel or iSCSI
questions.explanation: SAN = block devices to servers; NAS = file-level shares.

questions.question: Using the table emp shown, what does the query return?
questions.code:
name | dept | sal
A    | IT   | 50
B    | IT   | 70
C    | HR   | 40
D    | HR   | NULL
E    | OPS  | 60

SELECT dept, COUNT(sal) FROM emp
GROUP BY dept HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY dept;
questions.explanation: HAVING keeps HR and IT (2 rows each); COUNT(sal) skips D's NULL, so HR counts 1.

questions.question: Using the table emp shown, what does the query return?
questions.code:
name | dept | sal
A    | IT   | 50
B    | IT   | 70
C    | HR   | 40
D    | HR   | NULL
E    | OPS  | 60

SELECT AVG(sal) FROM emp;
questions.explanation: AVG ignores NULL: (50 + 70 + 40 + 60) / 4 = 55.

questions.question: Which isolation level prevents dirty reads but still allows non-repeatable reads?
questions.explanation: READ COMMITTED reads only committed data, but a re-read can see another transaction's new commit.

questions.question: R(A, B, C) has only the dependencies A → B and B → C. The highest normal form R satisfies is:
questions.explanation: The key is A, so there is no partial dependency (2NF), but A → B → C is transitive, breaking 3NF.

questions.question: Which statement lists the privileges held by the MySQL account 'lab'@'localhost'?
questions.explanation: SHOW GRANTS FOR user prints the GRANT statements for that account.

questions.question: How do you restore the dump file college.sql into an existing database named college?
questions.explanation: A mysqldump file is plain SQL, so the mysql client replays it; mysqldump only exports.

questions.question: Which statement shows how MySQL plans to execute a SELECT, including whether it uses an index?
questions.explanation: EXPLAIN SELECT ... shows the access type, key used and estimated rows.

questions.question: In MySQL 8, the role 'reader' is granted to 'lab'@'localhost'. By default, its privileges take effect in lab's sessions only after:
options: the role is activated with SET ROLE or made a default with SET DEFAULT ROLE
nothing; they are active at once
questions.explanation: Granted roles are inactive until activated, unless activate_all_roles_on_login is ON.

questions.question: What does git reset --soft HEAD~1 do?
options: undoes the last commit but keeps its changes staged
deletes the last commit and its changes
undoes the last commit and unstages its changes
creates a new commit that reverses the last one
questions.explanation: --soft moves HEAD only; --mixed (default) also unstages; --hard also discards; revert makes a new commit.

questions.question: In the DN uid=ravi,ou=people,dc=iitk,dc=ac,dc=in, the relative distinguished name (RDN) is:
questions.explanation: The RDN is the leftmost component; the rest is the parent entry's DN.

questions.question: The iptables INPUT chain has rule 1: -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT and rule 2: -s 10.0.0.5 -j DROP. An SSH connection from 10.0.0.5 is:
options: dropped, because the more specific rule wins
questions.explanation: iptables stops at the first matching rule in order.

questions.question: What does rsync -a --delete /data/ /backup/data/ do?
options: copies /data and then deletes the source files
makes /backup/data an exact copy, removing files that no longer exist in /data
copies only new files and never removes anything
questions.explanation: --delete removes files on the receiver that are absent on the sender; -a keeps permissions and times.

questions.question: After adding a field to a Django model, which pair of commands updates the database?
options: python manage.py migrate, then python manage.py runserver
python manage.py startapp, then python manage.py migrate
python manage.py makemigrations, then python manage.py migrate
questions.explanation: makemigrations writes the migration file; migrate applies it. syncdb was removed in Django 1.9.

partc.title: Office note (10 marks, about 150 words).
partc.prompt: The CSE department's 40 lab PCs run an operating system that reaches end of support in three months. Prepare an office note for the Head of the Department proposing an upgrade before the next semester. Give the background, the proposal with an estimated cost of Rs. 2.4 lakh for licences and staff time, and the approval you are seeking.
partc.guide: Format 3: heading "NOTE" or "Office Note", file or reference number, subject line, numbered paragraphs, "Submitted for approval" (or "for kind consideration"), signature with name, designation and date. No salutation and no "Yours faithfully" (it is not a letter). Content 4: background (40 PCs, end of support in three months, security risk), proposal (upgrade schedule before the semester, testing, backup of data), cost (Rs. 2.4 lakh, budget head), the specific approval sought. Language 3: impersonal, concise, third person ("It is proposed that..."), no contractions.

partc.title: Report (10 marks, about 200 words).
partc.prompt: You were asked to carry out the annual stock verification of the CSE computer lab. You found 58 of the 60 PCs, 2 projectors missing their remote controls, 3 UPS units with dead batteries, and 4 network switches not entered in the stock register. Write a report to the Head of the Department on the verification and your recommendations.
partc.guide: Format 3: title, To / From / Date / Subject (or a report heading block), headed sections: Introduction (who ordered it, when, scope), Method, Findings, Recommendations, Conclusion; signature with name and designation. Content 4: all four findings with numbers (2 PCs not traced, 2 remotes missing, 3 UPS batteries dead, 4 switches unregistered), the likely reasons, recommendations (search and report the 2 PCs to the store, replace batteries, enter switches in the register, a movement register for equipment), and a date for follow-up. Language 3: past tense for what was done, facts not guesses, no blame without evidence, about 200 words.

partc_note: Self-marking out of 10 each: format 3, content 4, language 3.
